owis.englishMeaning: mouna was established in Its own `aloneness' and then `there' this `word' `I am' appeared. This is the so-ham appearing in your inner space.

owis.original: धरितां सो सांडितां हं । अखंड चाले सोहं सोहं । याचा विचार पाहातां बहु । विस्तारला ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्वास घेतांना सो असा सूक्ष्म आवाज होतो. आणि श्वास सोडतांना हं असा सूक्ष्म आवाज होतो. अशा रीतीनें अखंड सोहं सोहं शब्द चालतो. याचा विचार करावयाचा तर त्याचा विस्तार फार मोठा आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When the inhalation is so and the exhalation is ham then, that unbroken brahman is moving as so-ham, so-ham (the gross world is not seen and there is the understanding `I am everywhere'). But when you understand then, this `speech' that had expanded into the `many' thoughts becomes that thoughtless Self (from that thoughtless comes this `speech' and from this comes the `many' concepts. But when this so-ham is being understood ie. japa, then the `many' other thoughts cannot arise and so an objective world cannot exist).

owis.original: देहधारक तितुका प्राणी । श्र्वेतजउद्भिजादिक खाणी । स्वासोस्वास नस्तां प्राणी । कैसे जिती ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वेदज, उद्बिज, जारज आणि अंडज असे चार खाणींमधील जे देहधारक प्राणी आहेत, त्या सर्वांना श्वासोश्वास आहे. त्याविना देहधारक प्राणी जगूंच शकत नाहीत. वनस्पतींना देखील प्राणवायूची गरज असते. त्यांच्यामधें जीवनकला असते. हें संत जाणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is a holder of the body and these `many' thoughts in the prana then, that One gets born from the four sources of birth; the egg, the womb etc. And then if it does not breathe in the prana, how can that One live? (Therefore give your attention to that which is essential; this breath. Then this `all' or life can be understood. Why to give your attention to those things that are not at all essential)

owis.original: ऐसी हे अजपा सकळासा । परंतु कळे जाणत्यासी । सहज सांडून सायासीं । पडोंच नये ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा रीतीनें सर्व सजीव प्राण्यांमधें अजपा श्वासोश्वासाबरोबर चालूं असतो. ही विनासायास होणारी अजपा फक्त जाणत्यांनाच आकलन होते. सहज चालणारी ही अजपा सोडून कष्टाच्या साधनामागें जाऊं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: This `speech' (japa) is that thoughtless ajapa but this is understood only by the Knower. Therefore that One should not leave that which is natural and make great efforts (V.4).

owis.original: सहज देव असतचि असे । सायासें देव फुटे नासे । नासिवंत देवास विश्र्वासे । ऐसा कवणु ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देव आपले स्वस्वरुप असल्यानें तो आपल्यापाशीं नेहमी सहज असतोच. सायासानें व कष्टानें निर्माण केलेला देव तुटतो, फुटतो व नाश पावतो. नाशवंत देवावर कोणी विश्र्वास ठेवीत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: The natural God is as He only is. By making effort that God gets scattered into the `many' gods and disappears in the prana (forgetting our Self we create `many' concepts and drown in confusion). Therefore why should one have faith in these destructible gods?

owis.original: जगदांतराचें दर्शन । सहज घडे अखंड ध्यान । आत्मइछेनें जन । सकळ वर्तती ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगामध्यें अंतर्यामीपणानें राहणार्‍या अंतरात्म्याचें दर्शन सहज घडतें. त्याचे ध्यान अखंड राहणें हेच त्याचे दर्शन होय. त्या अंतरात्म्याच्या इच्छेने सर्व प्राणीमात्र वागतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the understanding of this inner space `I am' then, that natural and unbroken is making meditation (ie. the triad of Knower, knowing and known arises). Then the mind has this wish (to know or just be) of that atma and it exists as `I am'.

owis.original: आत्मयाचे समाधान । घडे तैसेंचि आशन । सांडलें फिटलें समर्पण । तयासीच होये ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतरात्म्याचे समाधान होईल असें खाणें प्रत्येक प्राण्याचे घडत असतें. त्याचप्रमाणें जें सांडतें, लवंडते, हरवतें हे देखील अंतरात्म्यालाच समर्पण होते.
owis.englishMeaning: And when there is that samadhan (ie. nirgun understanding) of the atma then, even the functions of eating food and going to the toilet are all offered to that Reality.

owis.original: अग्नपुरुष पोटीं वसती । तयास अवदानें सकळ देती । लोक आज्ञेमधें असती । आत्मयांचे ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रत्येक प्राण्याच्या पोटांत अग्निनारायण वास करतो. त्या जठराग्नीला सर्वजण आहुती देतात. अशा रीतीनें सर्व प्राणी त्या अंतरात्म्याच्या आज्ञेंतच वागतात.
owis.englishMeaning: This fire and that purush are everywhere and they even reside within the belly (ie. this fire is the knowing of something other than yourself and it is always accompanied by that purush or Knower) and whatever gets offered to this `all', this `all' will give to the atma purush. For this and no more is what that atma asks of this `all' (maharaj- the ignorant offer their actions to brahman but they are not aware of this; the gnyani understands that he offers his actions to brahman).

owis.original: सहज देवजपध्यानें । सहज चालणें स्तुती स्तवनें । सहज घडे तें भगवान्नें । मान्य कीजे ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या अंतर्यामी अंतरात्मा अगदी सहज आहे. त्याचा जप, ध्यान सहज चाललेम पाहिजे. आपलें सहज बोलणें चालणें हीच त्याची स्तुति व स्तवन . अशा रीतीनें जें सहज घडेल तेंच भगवंताला मान्य होतें.
owis.englishMeaning: When that natural God makes this japa meditation (so-ham) to God then, He is moving around singing His own praises (ie. He is seeing His own reflection). And when that natural swarup has been accomplished by that purush then, That only should be respected (then that which is natural should never again lose Itself doing unnatural practices ie. japa/so-ham, meditation etc. trying to gain Itself).

owis.original: सहज समजायाकारणें । नाना हटयोग करणें । परंतु येकायेकीं समजणेंद्र । घडत नाहीं ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ही सहजावस्था काय आहे हें समजण्यासाठीं साधकाला अनेक कठीण साधनें करावी लागतात. अनेक साधनें केल्याखेरीज सहजावस्था कशी असते तें चटकन समजणें जमत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: For to understand that which is natural there is the making of the `many' hatha- yogas but they will never bring the understanding of that One that is within this `all' (they can bring the sagun understanding/knowledge but cannot bring vignyan/beyond Knowledge).

owis.original: द्रव्य चुकतें दरिद्र येतें । तळीं लक्ष्मी वरी वर्ततें । प्राणी काये करील तें । ठाउकें नाहीं ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: द्रव्य आहे तें पुरुन ठेवलेले आहे. त्याची जागा चुकली कीं द्रव्य असून दारिद्र्य येते. माणूस ज्या ठिकाणीं बसतो त्याच्या खालींच द्रव्य तळाशीा असते. त्याचा व्यवहार वर चालतो. त्याला माहित नसतें. त्यामुळें तो दारिद्र्य भोगतो.
owis.englishMeaning: And if this sagun is forgotten then, there is the objectification that brings the misery and poverty of body consciousness. Then *lakshmi gets buried and hidden within your house (ie. body) in the prana and what will that Reality not know (then so many things/concepts will come)? *(lakshmi means wealth but it is this great spiritual wealth of `I am')

owis.original: तळघरामधें उदंड द्रव्य । भिंतीमधें घातलें द्रव्य । स्तंभी तुळवटीं द्रव्य । आपण मधें ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तळघरामध्यें खूप द्रव्य असतें, भिंती, खांब व तुळ्या द्रव्यांनी भरलेल्या असतात. असें सभोवती द्रव्य भरलेले असून हा त्यामध्यें दरिद्रीपणानें राहतो.
owis.englishMeaning: In the basement of this house there is that vast paramatma and this power of objectification and this objectification has hidden and confined that paramatma within these walls of this house. For when this power of objectification arises within you then, that paramatma is hidden in the pillars, columns and wooden beams (then upon that one paramatma we create so `many' things).4

owis.original: लक्ष्मीमध्यें करंटा नांदे । त्याचें दरिद्र अधीक सांदे । नवल केलें परमानंदें । परमपुरुषें ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आजुबाजुला संपत्ती असून तिच्यामधें भाग्यहीन माणूस असतो. तेव्हां त्याचे करंटेपण अधिकच उठून दिसते. परमानंदस्वरुप परमात्म्यानें हा केवढा मोठा चमत्कार केलेला आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Then though dwelling within lakshmi, one lives in abject poverty and sometimes may get a little enjoyment. Yet that Supreme purush has made this marvel of that thoughtless swarup out of His own Supreme Bliss (ie. everything is that Supreme purush enjoying its own Supreme Bliss. But when you take yourself to be a body then, there there are the endless rounds of pain and pleasure).

owis.original: येक पाहाती येक खाती । ऐसी विवेकाची गती । प्रवृत्ति अथवा निवृत्ती । येंणेंचि न्यायें ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: व्यवहारामध्यें जसा श्रीमंत माणूस ऐश्वर्य भोगतो आणि दरिद्री माणूस त्याच्याकडे नुसता बघत बसतो, तसा परमार्थांत जो विवेकशील असतो तो भगवंताचा आनंद भोगतो व जो विवेकशील नाहीं तो त्याच्याकडे नुसता आशाळभूतपणें बघत बसतो. विवेकशील माणूस प्रपंचांतून निवृत्त होऊन अंतरात्म्याला ओळखतो तर अविवेकी माणूस दृश्यामध्यें प्रवृत होऊन नाना प्रकारची प्रापंचिक दुःखें भोगतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That One has understood the offering of everything to this `all' and the other one lives as a jiva and consumes food only. Such are their states of vivek. Either there are the actions of this world/pravritti due to wrong thinking or there is the withdrawal from this world/nivritti, due to that thoughtless understanding.

owis.original: अंतरीं वसतां नारायेणें । लक्ष्मीस काये उणें । ज्याची लक्ष्मी तो आपणें । बळकट धरवा ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याच्या अंतर्यामीं नारायण वस्ती करतो त्याला लक्ष्मी कमी पडणें शक्य नाही. म्हणून लक्ष्मी ज्याच्या आधीन आहे तो नारायण आपण घट्ट धरुन ठेवावा.
owis.englishMeaning: If narayana dwells within this inner space then, what will lakshmi, His consort, ever want for? Therefore the spiritual wealth of that purush should be firmly held by you (be that purush and claim your birthright). Note: ajapa is mouna and it is beyond this japa soham or the `word'. See the story of hanuman 16.6.25 onwards. When the prana inside and the wind outside are the same then, the pinda and brahmanda are also the same and one is freed of body consci- ousness. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Dehatma Nirupan (A Discourse on the Body and the Atma)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: आत्मा देहामध्यें असतो । नाना सुखदुःखें भोगितो । सेवटीं शरीर सांडून जातो । येकायेकीं ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मा देहांत राहतो आणि अनेक प्रकारची सुखदुःखें भोगतो. अखेर तो एकाएकी देह सोडून जातो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that atma is residing in the body then is has to endure the `many' pains or pleasures. Then this `all' body is left aside and in the end, the jiva suddenly dies (the jiva is born from this `all'/knowledge or `I am'/existence; this `I am' is life and therefore it is the constant support of the jiva. But the jiva steals this quality of existence from `here' and establishes itself, for a short time, as real. But then suddenly death comes; maharaj- this body is so faithless, it doesn't even say goodbye).

owis.original: शरीरीं शक्ति तारुण्यपणीं । नाना सुखें भोगी प्राणी । अशक्त होतां वृद्धपणीं । दुःखें भोगी ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तरुणपणीं शरीरांत शक्ति असते त्या जोरावर माणूस अनेक सुखें भोगतो. म्हातारपणीं शक्ति क्षीण होते व मग अनेक दुःखें भोगावी लागतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Within the `all' body there is this power of `I am' and it is this that brings the feeling of *youthfulness. In the prana, that One enjoys the `many' pleasures but when old age comes there is weakness and that One suffers `many' pains. *(maharaj- I am the youngest here)

owis.original: मरावेना ऐसी आवडी । हातपाये खोडून प्राण सोडी । नाना दुःखें अवघडी । वृद्धपणीं ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण मरुं नये असें प्रत्येकास मनापासून वाटतें. पण मृत्यु आला कीं, माणूस हातपाय झाडून प्राण सोदतो. म्हातारपणीं अनेक प्रकारच्या दुःखांनीं माणूस अवघडून जातो.
owis.englishMeaning: "I should not die." Because this is your earnest desire, there comes the struggling and fighting as the prana leaves the body (though you are that eternal Self, you feel, "I am dying now"). Before this there are `many' sufferings during the difficult and embarrassing time of old age.

owis.original: देहआत्मयांची संगती । कांहींयेक सुख भोगिती । चर्फडचर्फडून जाती । देहांतकाळीं ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देह व आत्मा यांची संगत झाली म्हणजे कांहीं सुखें भोगायला मिळतात. हें खरें, पण देह सुटायच्यावेळीं जीव अगदी धडपडून मरतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that atma and the body are together then, that One within this `thing' enjoys some pleasures but It flounders like a fish and cries out in pain when the end of life draws near.

owis.original: ऐसा आत्मा दुःखदायेक । येकांचे प्राण घेती येक । आणी सेवटीं निरार्थक । कांहींच नाहीं ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहात्मयोग अशारीतीनें दुःख देणारा होतो. जगांत स्वार्थानें माणसें एकमेकांचा प्राण घेतात. पण शेवटीं हें सगळें व्यर्थ जातें. त्याचा कांहीं उपयोग होत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: In this way, that atma becomes a giver of pain, for that One atma has taken Itself to be the prana of a jiva. And in the end, It dies to a life that had no *meaning and even this `thing' was not understood.5 *(This precious beautiful thing called life ie. `I am' was not understood, for you, that atma, took Yourself to be a little powerless jiva)

owis.original: ऐसा दों दिसांचा भ्रम । त्यास म्हणती परब्रह्म । नाना दुःखाचा संभ्रम । मानून घेतला ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असा हा दोन दिवसांचा दृश्याचा भ्रम आहे. त्यालाच परब्रह्म समजून, सर्वस्व मानून लोक जगतात. या दुःखाच्या पसार्‍याला लोक गोड मानून घेतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Such is this delusion of only `two days' (we always think of yesterday and tomorrow and never are in the present/now) and they call that parabrahman! Even though your `many' thoughts are a whirling of confusion and bewilderment still, you esteemed and valued them.

owis.original: दुःखी होऊन चर्फडून गेले । तेथें कोण समाधान जालें । कांहींयेक सुख भोगिलें । तों सवेंचि दुःख ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दुःख भोगावें लागल्यानें चरफडत जाण्याची पाळी आली तर त्यांत कांहींही समाधान मिळत नाहीं. थोडें कांहीं सुख भोगायला जावें तर त्याच्याबरोबर दुःख भोगावें लागतें.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is this living in misery and the floundering like a dying fish in the end then, how can there be that samadhan `there'? When that One within this `thing' enjoys these pleasures then He, of His own accord, has to endure suffering afterwards.

owis.original: जन्मदारभ्य आठवावें । म्हणिजे अवघें पडेल ठावें । नाना दुःख मोजावें । काये म्हणोनी ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जन्मल्यापासूनचें आपलें जीवन आपण आठवावें, म्हणजे सगळें आपोआप ध्यानांत येईल. आपण इतकीं दुःखें भोगलेलीं असतात कीम त्यांची मोजदाद करतां येणार नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When you remember the sufferings endured since your birth then, due to these `many' thoughts, this place of the `all' will come tumbling down into a body (remembering your so-called past, brings body consciousness). Therefore why should the `many' sufferings be regarded (ie. why to recall a past, it only creates the illusion of an entity that had suffered. You are knowledge, beyond a past or future)?

owis.original: ऐसी आत्मयांची संगती । नाना दुःखें प्राप्त होती । दैन्यवाणे होऊन जाती । प्राणीमात्र ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहाशीं आत्म्याची संगत ही अशी आहे. देहात्मयोगानें जीवाला अनेक दुःखें भोगावीं लागतात. आयुष्याच्या शेवटीं सारे प्राणी दीनवाणें होऊन मरतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When that atma is attached to the body then, it attains only the `many' pains. When that One lives in the prana only then, it tastes the fruits of misery and in the end it has to go away. (That unbound atma knows that these pleasures and pains are sensations only that appear in knowledge; but due to an attachment to the gross body, the individual mind is created and that dwells on these sensations and calls them pleasurable and painful etc.; maharaj- there is no pain, it is a sensation only....pain is a sensation that you are not used to)

owis.original: कांहीं आनंद कांहीं खेद । जन्मवरी पडिला समंध । नाना प्रकारीं विरुद्ध । तडातोडी ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कांहीं सुख व कांहीं दुःख, असा हा जन्माचा संबंध असतो. त्यामध्यें नाना प्रकारच्या मनाविरुद्ध गोष्टी घडतात, तसेंच अनेकांची ताटातूट होते.
owis.englishMeaning: This `thing' is bliss when understood and this `thing' is suffering (ie. when there are the `many' thoughts). Up until you take a birth there is this *`all' connection of bliss but when you take birth in the ways of the `many' then, there is enmity and estrangement and suffering. *(When one takes a birth in the body ie. as soon as one thinks of this world then, one accepts the thought, "I am a body" and immediately this `all' connection is broken. But if this `all' connection is thoroughly understood then, at that time, you are not a body and when that atma is understood then you understand that you were never born)

owis.original: निद्राकाळीं ढेकूण पिसा । नाना प्रकारीं वळसा । नाना उपायें वळसा । त्यांस होये ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: झोपेच्या वेळीं ढेकूण आणि पिसवा अनेक प्रकारें माणसाला त्रास देतात. माणूस त्यांचा प्रतिकार करतो. तेव्हां त्यांनाहीं अनेक प्रकारें त्रास होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When one is asleep to the Self then, there is this stinking pot and the madness of body consciousness. Then within the ways of the `many' that One makes a loud bewildering uproar and that atma gets troubled by the `many' remedies.

owis.original: भोजनकाळीं माश्या येती । नाना पदार्थ उंदीर नेती । पुढें त्यांची हि फजिती । मार्जारें करिती ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जेवायला बसलें कीं माश्या येऊन त्रास देतात. उंदीर कितीतरी पदार्थ घेऊन जातात. नंतर मांजरें त्यांची फजिती करतात. त्यांना त्रास देतात.
owis.englishMeaning: In body consciousness, flies come while the food is being enjoyed; the `many' objects get taken away by the rats and for the rats there is terrible fear and suffering due to the cats (every jiva has to suffer at the hands of another jiva and so constant fear pervades our being)

owis.original: वा चामवा गोंचिड । गांधेलें कानटें उदंड । येकास येक चर्फड । दोहिकडे ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उवा, चामवा, कातड्यांत शिरणारे किडे, गोचीड, गांधील माश्या, कानटे नावाचे सर्प, असे नाना प्रकारचे प्राणी आहेत. या प्राण्यांत एकमेकाविषयीं वैर असतें. त्यामुळें सर्वांना दुःख भोगावें लागतें.
owis.englishMeaning: That vast paramatma has become these lice, fleas, horse gnats, gadflies and tiny wa- ter creatures; and then that One (as a jiva) tosses around in distress and suffering from their bites. While that One who understands resides in the bliss of this purush/prakruti. (siddharameshwar maharaj- when you lovingly offer your blood to the bed-bug then, great joy will arise within you)

owis.original: विंचु सर्प वाग रिसें । सुसरी लांडिगे माणसास माणसें । परस्परें सुखसंतोषें । येकहि नाहीं ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विंचू, साप, वाघ, अस्वल, सुसरी, लांडगे आणि माणसाला माणसें या सर्व प्राण्यांमध्यें परस्परांबद्दल प्रेम, सुख व संतोष कोठेंहि आढळत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Otherwise there are scorpions, serpents, tigers, bears, crocodiles, foxes and one man against another man (ie. `many' fears due to objectification). Then due to this feeling of separateness, that One does not enjoy happiness and contentment.

owis.original: चौर्‍यासि लक्ष उत्पत्ती । येकास येक भक्षिती । नाना पीडा दुःखणी किती । म्हणौन सांगावें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगांत येवढे चौर्‍यांशी लक्ष प्राणी आहेत, पण ते एकमेकांना खातात. जगांत पीडांचे व दुःखांचे इतके प्रकार आहेत कीं, त्या सर्वांचे वर्णन करणें अशक्य आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When one takes birth in this `attention of the eighty-four' then, the One (as a jiva) devours that One (brahman). The `many' thoughts bring pain and great distress and therefore the `many' thoughts should understand thoughtlessness.

owis.original: ऐसी अंतरात्म्याची करणी । नाना जीव दाटले धरणी । परस्परें संव्हारणी । येकायेकांची ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्या अंतरात्म्याची करणी अशी विलक्षण आहे. या पृथ्वीवर अनेक प्रकारचे जीव गर्दी करुन आहेत. ते परस्परांचा संहार करतात.
owis.englishMeaning: All this is the doing of that antar-atma (ie. all this takes place in knowledge only), yet the `many' jivas fill this world and due to this feeling of separation they say, "I do" and destroy that One by the other one (jiva). (As soon as the jiva drops its sense of "I do", it would discover `He does')

owis.original: अखंड रडती चर्फडिती । विवळोंविवळ प्राण देती । मूर्ख प्राणी त्यास म्हणती । परब्रह्म ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जीवनामध्यें माणूस दुःखानें सारखा रडतो., चरफडतो, दुःखानेम विव्हळून प्राण देतो. अशा या दुःखमय जीवात्म्याला लोक परब्रह्म मानतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that unbroken brahman laments and tosses in irritation and while moaning and groaning, the prana is given up and It dies. And the foolish in the prana, they call that parabrahman.

owis.original: परब्रह्म जाणार नाहीं । कोणास दुःख देणार नाहीं । स्तुति निंदा दोनी नाहीं । परब्रह्मीं ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परब्रह्म शाश्वत असल्यानें तें कधीं जात नाहीं. तें कोणास दुःख देणार नाहीं. त्याच्या ठिकाणीं निंदा व स्तुति दोन्ही स्पर्श करुं शकत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: parabrahman will not go away. Who can It give pain to? Neither praise nor censure affect this prakruti/purush so how could they be found in parabrahman.

owis.original: उदंड शिव्या दिधल्या । तितुक्या अंतरात्म्यास लागल्या । विचार पाहातां प्रत्यया आल्या । येथातथ्य ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्यानें खूप शिव्या दिल्या तर त्या सगळ्या अंतरात्म्यास लागतात. विचार करुन पाहिलें तर हा अगदी असाच अनुभव येतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that vast paramatma gets abused in the prana then, this inner-atma takes the touch and gets affected. But when thoughtlessness is understood then, that antar-atma becomes that nirgun brahman.

owis.original: धगडीचा बटकीचा लवंडीचा । गधडीचा कुतरीचा वोंगळीचा । ऐसा हिशेब सिव्यांचा । किती म्हणोनि सांगावा ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: धगडीचा, बटकीचा, लवंडीचा, गधडीचा, कुतरीचा, चांडाळणीचा अशा कितीतरी शिव्या आहेत. त्या सर्व सांगता येणार नाहींत.
owis.englishMeaning: "You son of an ass, you son of a whore, you son of a bitch, you son of a filthy woman." Such is the abuse It receives in the prana. Therefore the `many' thoughts should understand thoughtlessness.

owis.original: इतुकें परब्रह्मीं लागेना । तेथें कल्पनाचि चालेना । तडातोडीचें ज्ञान मानेना । कोणीयेकासी ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पण यापैकीं कांहींसुद्धा परब्रह्मास स्पर्श करुं शकत नाहीं. परब्रह्माच्या ठिकाणीं मानवी कल्पना चालूंच शकत नाहीं. असंबद्ध ज्ञान कोणासही मान्य होणार नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: In that parabrahman all these abuses have no affect; for `there' imagination cannot work. For this knowledge of separate objects is not respected by that One who is within everyone.

owis.original: सृष्टीमधें सकळ जीव । सकळांस कैचे वैभव । याकारणें ठायाठाव । निरमिला देवें ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सगळे प्राणी या पृथ्वीवर जगतात. पण ते सगळें कांहीं वैभव भोगित नाहीत. सगळ्यांना वैभव भोगावयास मिळत नाहीं याचा अर्थ असा कीं, भगवंतानें प्रत्येकाचें स्थान ठरवून त्यास निर्माण केलें आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: But when this `all' is a jiva in the gross world then, how can there be the grandeur and glory of this `all'? Due to God, this `speech' was created and due to this `speech', these `many' different places have appeared (though you are this One God, you have become a jiva by first having this wish `to be' and then this wish to be a body. The- refore realize that there is no point blaming God or your luck or your destiny for this predicament and that everything is in your hands. Either you can hold on to the con- viction that you are a jiva or you can hold the conviction that you are the thoughtless God and with this `speech' of the `all' return to your rightful place `there').

owis.original: उदंड लोक बाजारीचे । जें जें आलें तें तें वेंचे । उत्तम तितुके भाग्याचे । लोक घेती ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बाजार भरला म्हणजे पुष्कळ लोक बाजारांत येतात. त्यापैंकी बहुतेक माणसें अशीं असतात कीं, जो कांहीं माल विकायला आला असेल तो ते विकत घेतात. परंतु त्यांच्यापैकीं जे भाग्यवान असतात तेच तेवढें उत्तम वस्तु घेऊन जातात. त्याचप्रमाणें या संसाराच्या बाजारांत बहुजनसमाज प्रपंचाच्या मागें धांवतो. थोडीं पुण्यवान माणसें भगवंताच्या नादी लागून भगवंताची प्राप्ती करुन घेतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When that vast paramatma becomes this market place of the world then, whatever maya brings is taken as its Reality (its base is the Truth but maya causes That to be forgotten. Then the jiva takes this market place as the Truth and even if this `all' is understood still, this is taken as that Truth). But when that One accepts the best guna then, he is blessed and attains this world of the `all'.

owis.original: येणेंचि न्यायें अन्न वसन । येणेंचि न्यायें देवार्चन । येणेंचि न्यायें ब्रह्मज्ञान । प्राप्तव्यासारिखें ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अन्नवस्त्र, देवपूजा आणि ब्रह्मज्ञान यांच्या बाबतींत हाच न्याय लागूं पडतो. माणसाचें अन्नवस्त्र, त्याच्या हातून घडणारें देवतार्चन आणि त्यास प्राप्त होणारे ब्रह्मज्ञान या तिन्ही गोष्टी नियतीवर अवलंबून असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of this `all' there are the essentials of life (ie. `I am'/existence and `I know'/knowledge); on account of this there is this worship of God; and on account of this there is the attainment of that knowledge of brahman.

owis.original: अवघेच लोक सुखी असती । संसार गोड करुन नेती । माहाराजे वैभव भोगती । तें करंट्यास कैचें ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगांत सगळेच लोक सुखी असतात. आपला संसार जसा असेल तसा तें गोड करुन घेतात. परंतु महाराजे जें वैभव भोगतात तें कांहीं करंट्यांच्या वाट्यास येत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: If the `many' thoughts become this `all' world, full of happiness, then this samsar is made sweet before it gets taken away (ie. knowledge must also end). But how can the pauper enjoy the grandeur and glory of that great King?

owis.original: परंतु अंती नाना दुःखें । तेथें होतें सगट सारिखें । पूर्वी भोगिलीं नाना सुखें । अंतीं दुःख सोसवेना ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसाला शेवटीं अनेक प्रकारची दुःखें भोगावी लागतात. सर्व माणसांना ती सारख्याच स्वरुपांत भोगावी लागतात. अयुष्यांत आधी सुखें भोगलेलीं असल्यामुळें अंतकाळीं होणारीं दुःखें सोसवत नाहींत.
owis.englishMeaning: If at the end there are the `many' miseries then, it is because `there' had been lumped together like a market place. When there has been only the enjoyment of the `many' pleasures then, at the end, there will be only unbearable miseries.

owis.original: कठिण दुःख सोसवेना । प्राण शरीर सोडिना । मृत्यदुःख सगट जना । कासाविस करी ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कठीण दुःखें सोसवत नाहींत आणि प्राण तर जाता जात नाहीं. अशा रीतीनें मरणकाळचें दुःख सर्व लोकांना सारखेंच कासावीस करुन सोडते.
owis.englishMeaning: And even though the harsh pain of maya is unbearable still, the prana and the body are not given up. Thus when the people *lump together everything as the same then, that atma is the giver of extreme suffering and the pain of death. *(When there is no vivek)

owis.original: नाना अवेवहीन जालें । तैसेंचि पाहिजे वर्तलें । प्राणीं अंतःकाळीं गेलें । कासाविस होऊनी ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: रोगानें किंवा अपघातानें कोणाचें अवयव निकामी होतात किंवा तोडावें लागतात. पण अशा अवयवहीन अवस्थेंत माणसाला जीवनाचे व्यवहार करावें लागतात. अशी सगळीं माणसें अंतकाळीं कासावीस होऊन मरतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The world of the `many' is only an inferior part of that *atma and if like this only one wants to stay then, in the prana there is the great distress of death. *(That which has no parts)

owis.original: रुप लावण्य अवघें जातें । शरीरसामर्थ्य अवघें राहातें । कोणी नस्तां मरतें । आपदआपदों ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसाचें रुप किंवा सौंदर्य तें सगळें नष्ट होतें. शरीरांतील सामर्थ्य नाहींसें होतें. जवळ कोणी असत नाहीं. अशा परिस्थितींत यातना भोगीत माणूस मरतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to the `many' things, the lustre and grace of knowledge disappears; due to the `many' things, the body of this `all' ceases to exist and everyone has to suffer and then die in lingering pain.

owis.original: अंतकाळ दैन्य दीन । सकळिकांस तत्समान । ऐसें चंचळ अवलक्षण । दुःखकारी ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतकाल सर्वंना सारखाच असतो. त्यावेळीं माणसाची फार दीनवाणी अवस्था होतें. अशाश्वताचे दुःखकारक अवलक्षण हें असें आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: At the time of death, this `all' becomes like the body, miserable and pitiable (ie. even knowledge/`all' has to be forgotten if death is to come). For even this attention of the moving `all' is false and so, in truth, it is the giver of pain (knowledge is a form of attention ie. the birth of duality and therefore the misery of death cannot be avoided).

owis.original: भोगून अभोक्ता म्हणती । हे तों अवघीच फजिती । लोक उगेच बोलती । पाहिल्याविण ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भोग भोगून अभोक्तेपणा ठेवावा अशी भाषा लोक बोलतात. पण ही सगळी फजिती आहे. खरें पाहिल्यावाचून लोक उगीच कांहींतरी बोलतात. भोग भोगीत असतांना मनानें त्यापासून अलिप्त राहणें ही कांहीं सामान्य गोष्ट नव्हें. देहदुःख आलें असतां मोठमोठे साधक अनुसंधानापासून खालीं घसरतात. किंबहुना देहदुःख व दारिद्र्य या दोन अवस्थांत भगवंतास यत्किंचित दोष न देतां जो आपलें अनुसंधान यथास्थित सांभाळतो, तोच साधकाच्या पदावर स्थिर झाला असें खात्रीनें समजावें. बाकीचे साधक खरें पण परीक्षा पास झालेले साधक नव्हेत.
owis.englishMeaning: If while enjoying life, that One says, "I am the non-enjoyer" (ie. has only intellectual understanding), then that thoughtless purush is in the wretched plight of the `many' thoughts. Then there is only this world of death and though that still and silent is `speaking', still It has no understanding of this `speech' (though the presence of that Reality and this knowledge/life are essential to stay in the world still, there is no understanding of them).

owis.original: अंतकाळ आहे कठिण । शेरीर सोडिना प्राण । बराड्यासारिखें लक्षण । अंतःकाळीं ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतकाळ फार कठीण आहे. जीव वासनेंत गुंतल्यानें प्राण शरीराला सोडता सोडीत नाहीं. त्यामुळें सामान्य माणसाची अवस्था एखाद्या भिकार्‍यासारखीं अगदी दीनवाणी बनतें.
owis.englishMeaning: The end is harsh if this `all' body has not given up the prana (but if the `all' is understood then, the prana is merged in the wind). Then the attention at the time of death is like that of a beggar (ie. then the understanding, `I am deathless, formless' thinks, "I am dying, please someone help me"). .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Jagjivan Nirupan (A Discourse on the Life of the World)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: मुळीं उदक निवळ असतें । नाना वल्लीमधें जातें । संगदोषें तैसें होतें । आंब्ल तिक्षण कडवट ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पाणी मुळामध्यें स्वच्छ असते. अनेक प्रकारच्या वेली वनस्पतींमध्यें तें शिरते आणि त्यांच्या संगतीचा दोष लागून तें आंबट, तिखट किंवा कडू बनतें.
owis.englishMeaning: At the root, this great water element is clear (free of any objectification) and af- terwards, it goes into the `many' creepers (and there are `many' thoughts, concepts, opinions and imaginings). Then that atma, due to Its union with this flawed body, appears like that only and It becomes sour and sorrowful, bitter and callous, stern, fa- natical and passionate (just like water, that pure atma accepts the qualities of whatever It is mixed with).

owis.original: आत्मा आत्मपणें असतो । देहसंगें विकारतो । साभिमानें भरीं भरतो । भलतिकडे ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याचप्रमाणें आत्मा मुळांत आत्मस्वरुपानें शुद्ध असतो. त्याला देहाची संगत लाभली कीं, त्याचें शुद्धपण लोपते. आणि त्याच्यांत विकार उत्पन्न होतात. अभिमानाच्या भरांत तो भलत्याच भरीला पडतो.
owis.englishMeaning: There is that atma and being the atma is Its nature. But That modifies due to Its union with the different bodies. For on account of this great pride `I am', that atma is filled with `many' false and irrelevant thoughts ("I am like this and that").

owis.original: बरी संगती सांपडली । जैसी उंसास गोडी आली । विषवल्ली फापांवली । घातकी प्राणी ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पाण्याला चांगली संगत लाभली कीं तें चांगलें होतें. जसें की, उसाची संगत लाभली की पाण्याचा गोड रस होतो. परंतु विषारी वेलीची संगत लागली तर त्याच पाण्याचा प्राणघातक रस होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: But if It finds wise companionship then, It is just like the sweetness that comes to the sugarcane (and gives great satisfaction). And if it keeps companionship with a poisonous creeper (ie. objectifies) then, it will grow and expand and finally die in the prana.

owis.original: अठराभार वनस्पती । गुण सांगावे ते किती । नाना देहाचे संगती । आत्मयास होये ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अठरा प्रकारच्या वनस्पती आहेत. प्रत्येकांत पाण्यास निरनिराळे गुण प्राप्त होतात. ते सगळें सांगणें शक्य नाहीं. अंतरात्म्याचे देखील असेंच घडते. निरनिराळ्या देहांच्या संगतीनें त्याच्यामध्यें निरनिराळे गुण आढळतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Just as that water acquires `many' qualities when it keeps the company of the countess herbs and plants in this world, so too, that one atma acquires `many' qualities when It keeps the company of the body (on account of that pure atma keeping the company of the gunas, It starts to objectify and `many' bodies are formed. But all this is simply imagination and in the end, that atma accepts a death in the prana).

owis.original: त्यामधें कोणी भले । ते संतसंगें निघाले । देहाभिमान सांडून गेले । विवेकबळें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहांत जें चांगलें असतात तें संतसंगतीनें कालक्रमणा करतात. सत् संगतीमुळें उत्पन्न होणार्‍या विवेकाच्या जोरावर ते देहाभिमान सोडून जातात. विवेकानें त्यांची देहबुद्धि नष्ट होते.
owis.englishMeaning: The one who stays in that atma with wisdom gets purified by the company of the Truth/satsang, for the body ego was let drop through steadfast vivek.

owis.original: उदजाचा नाशचि होतो । आत्मा विवेकें निघतो । ऐसा आहे प्रत्यय तो । विवेकें पाहा ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परंतु पाणी व अंतरात्मा यांच्यात फरक आहे. पाणी पंचभूतांपैकी आहे. म्हणून त्याचा नाश होतो. अंतरात्मा अविनाशी असल्यानें तो आत्मानात्म विवेकानें देहांतून बाहेर पडतो. असा प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव येतो. तो विचारानें ओळखावा.
owis.englishMeaning: When this water element (ie. beginning of forms) is destroyed by vivek then, that atma becomes indirectly apparent (ie. then there is the fire element ie. knowingness. When this is dropped, there is the wind element/knowledge and where there is wind, there must be space. This is witnessing and then that atma is felt to be close-by. maharaj- you say, "Nothing is there" but you forget, you are there). In this way, by becoming less objective, that nirgun can be understood. Therefore first understand this `I am' by vivek!

owis.original: ज्यास स्वहितचि करणें । त्यास किती म्हणौन सांगणें । हें ज्याचें त्यानें समजणें । सकळ कांहीं ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याला आपले कल्याण करुन घ्यायचे आहे, त्याला आणखी किती सांगायचें? ज्याचें त्यानेंच हें सर्व कांहीं समजून घेतलें पाहिजे.
owis.englishMeaning: If you want to do that which is in your own best interest then, the `many' thoughts should understand that thoughtless. And to do this there first should be this `all thing' of that purush (first give up the `many' thoughts and understand this sagun `experience' and then, merge this in that nirgun purush).

owis.original: आपला आपण करी कुडावा । तो आपला मित्र जाणावा । आपला नाश करी तो समजावा । वैरी ऐसा ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो स्वतःच स्वतःस सांभाळतो तो स्वतःचा मित्र समजावा. जो स्वतःच स्वतःचा नाश करतो, तो स्वतःचा शत्रु समजावा.
owis.englishMeaning: When that atma protects Its own Self then, that atma should be known as Its own best friend. But when that atma destroys Its Self then understand that It is Its own worst enemy.

owis.original: आपलें आपण अन्हित करावें । त्यास आडवें कोणें निघावें । येकांतीं जाऊन जीवें । मारी आपणासी ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो स्वतःचे अकल्याण करायला निघाला असेल, त्याला आडवें जाण्यांत अर्थ नाहीं. एकांतामध्यें जाऊन तो स्वतःच आपला जीव देतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If you want to hurt yourself then, who else is there other than yourself who can stop you going away from that atma (your true Self)? When that `aloneness' is destroyed, due to the jiva then, you are killing your Self.

owis.original: जो आपला आपण घातकी । तो आत्महत्यारा पातकी । याकारणें विवेकी । धन्य साधु ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो स्वतःच आपला घात करुन घेतो तो आत्महत्यारा पातकी समजावा. म्हणून आत्मानात्म विवेक करणारा साधु धन्य होय.
owis.englishMeaning: You, that purush, harm your own Self when you fall into body consciousness. You are committing suicide, for you are the killer of your atma. But by means of this `speech', there is the viveki and that blessed sadhu.

owis.original: पुण्यवंतां संत्सगती । पापिष्टां असत्संगती । गति आणि अवगती । संगतीयोगें ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पुण्यवान पुरुष सत् संगती धरतो. तर पापी वाईट संगति धरतो. त्या संगतीमुळें एकाला उत्तम गति मिळते तर दुसर्‍याला अधोगति मिळते.
owis.englishMeaning: The one who possesses this merit (`I am') gets the company of the True and the one who is body conscious gets the company of the untrue. Depending on the company, there is either the liberation of that Knower or there is the known.

owis.original: उत्तम संगती धरावी। आपली आपण चिंता करावी । अंतरीं बरी विवरावी । बुद्धि जाणत्याची ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून माणसानें उत्तम संगति धरावी. आपणच आपली काळजी घ्यावी. जाणत्या माणसाचे विचार घेऊन आपल्या अंतर्यामी त्यांचें विवरण करावें.
owis.englishMeaning: One should hold the company of the best and one should think of one's true Self. Therefore the wise should investigate this inner space and have the buddhi of that Knower of brahman (maharaj- He is not anything that can be seen or perceived; but still, He is there).

owis.original: इहलोक आणि परलोक । जाणता तो सुखदायेक । नेणत्याकरितां अविवेक । प्राप्त होतो ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: इहलोक असो किंवा परलोक असो, दोन्हीकडे जो जाणता असेल त्यास सुख लाभते. जो नेणता आहे तो दोन्हीकडे अविवेकानें वागतो.
owis.englishMeaning: There is the gross world and there is this world beyond. Knowing (ie. the world beyond) is the giver of great joy. But on account of not knowing (ie. the gross world), that atma loses proper discrimination.

owis.original: जाणता देवाचा अंश । नेणता म्हणिजे तो राक्षस । यामधें जें विशेष । तें जाणोन घ्यावें ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो जाणता आहे तो देवाचा अंश समजावा. तर नेणता आहे तो राक्षसाचा अंश समजावा. या दोन्हींत जें विशेष असेल, योग्य आणि ग्राह्य असेल , ते ओळखून ग्रहण करावें.
owis.englishMeaning: The one who knows is a part of God and when That does not know, then That should be called a demon (ie. ignorance). That pure knowledge/no knowledge is within this `speech' of mula maya and therefore this knowing should be accepted.

owis.original: जाणतां तो सकळां मान्य । नेणता होतो अमान्य । जेणेंकरितां होईजे धन्य । तेंचि घ्यावें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो जाणता असेल तो सगळ्यांना मान्य होतो. तर जो नेणता आहे तो सर्वांना अमान्य होतो. ज्याच्या योगानें आपण धन्य होऊन जाऊं, तेच आपण ग्राह्य करावें.
owis.englishMeaning: That Knower is revered by this `all' and the non-knower is reviled by this `all'. By means of mula maya, that most blessed Reality should be accepted.

owis.original: साक्षपी शाहाण्याची संगती । तेणें साक्षपी शाहाणें होती । आळसी मूर्खाची संगती । आळसी मूर्ख ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उद्योगी व शाहाण्या माणसाची संगत आपण धरली तर आपण देखील उद्योगी व शहाणे बनतो. आळशी व मूर्ख माणसाची संगत आपल्यला आळशी व मूर्ख बनवते.
owis.englishMeaning: When the alert keeps the company of the wise then, the alert becomes wise. When the lazy keeps the company of the foolish, then there is the lazy and foolish.

owis.original: उत्तम संगतीचें फळ सुख । अद्धम संगतीचें फळ दुःख । आनंद सांडुनियां शोक । कैसा घ्यावा ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उत्तम संगतीचे सुख हें फळ आहे. तर अधम संगतीचे दुःख हे फळ आहे. असें जर आहे तर आनंदाचा अव्हेर करुन मुद्दाम दुःख पत्करणें योग्य नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Happiness is the fruit of the best company and sorrow is the fruit of bad company. Tell me why should one leave aside bliss and accept sorrow?

owis.original: ऐसें हें प्रगट दिसे । जनामधें उदंड भासे । प्राणीमात्र वर्ततसे । उभयेयोगें ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगांत हें उघड दिसतें. लोकांमध्यें हें पुष्कळ पाहावयास मिळतें. कांहीं लोक सत्संगतीनें वागतात तर लोक असत्संगतीनें वागतात. तर कांहीं त्यामुळें बिघडतात. या दोन्ही गोष्टी पाहावयास मिळतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to bad company, that thoughtless Self manifests and gets seen through the senses and then, that vast paramatma appears in this world of the `many' people. Due to this union with both the best and the worst gunas there is the staying in only the prana (ie. rajo guna, "I am a body"). (The remedy is knowing and this is already with you; cherish this and expand yourself)

owis.original: येका योगें सकळ योग । येका योगें सकळ वियोग । विवेकयोगें सकळ प्रयोग । करीत जावे ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सज्जनांशी योग आला तर सगळ्या चांगल्या गोष्टी जुळून येतात. दुर्जनांशी योग आला तर सगळ्या गोष्टींचा विचका होतो. असें असल्यानें आपली सर्व कामें विवेकी पुरुषांच्या मदतीनें करीत जावीत.
owis.englishMeaning: This `all' becomes the atma due to its union with the best guna and this `all' becomes a jiva due to its union with the worst guna. But first, through vivek, this `all' should be created.

owis.original: अवचितें सांकडींत पडिलें । तरी तेथून पाहिजे निघालें । निघोन जातां जालें । परम समाधान ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: समजा एखादे अनपेक्षित संकट आपल्यावर आलें तर न घाबरतां विवेकानें आपण त्यांतून बाहेर पडावें. असे केल्यानें मनाला फार मोठे समाधान लाभते.
owis.englishMeaning: There has been this sudden, unexpected fall from `there' into this calamity (every morning knowledge awakes and then suddenly thoughts appear bringing body consci- ousness); still one should not remain away from `there'. And when one gets out from here, there will be the samadhan of that Supreme (that One has fallen into this calamity called body consciousness. Now, that One should learn how to drop body consciousness and return to its Self).

owis.original: नाना दुर्जनांचा संग । क्षणक्षणा मनभंग । याकारणें कांहीं रंग । राखोन जावें ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जीवनांत अनेक प्रकारच्या दुर्जनांशी संगत घडते. त्या योगानें पदोपदी आपला मानभंग होतो. आपल्या मनाविरुद्ध गोष्टी घडतात. या कराणानें आपलें महत्व राहील असेंच आपण वागावें.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the company of the `many' thoughts that are far from the atma then, that `moment of the One' becomes a mind broken into many forms. Therefore by means of this `speech', this glorious *`thing' should be protected always. *(A mind full of one thought, `I am')

owis.original: शाहाणा येत्न त्याच्या गुणें । पाहों जातां काये उणें । सुख संतोष भोगणें । नाना श्र्लाघ्यता ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मनुष्य जर शहाणपणानें प्रयत्न करील, तर त्या गुणानें माणसाला कांहींच कमी पडणार नाहीम. त्याच्या प्रयत्मनानें सुखसंतोष तर लाभेलच पण लोकांमध्यें त्याला महत्व प्राप्त होईल.
owis.englishMeaning: Wisdom and endeavour are with this pure sattwa guna of mula maya. What more is required when this is understood? Then there is the enjoyment of happiness and contentment and the praise of the `many' (maharaj- they say, "Oh! He is so great," only because they have not done it).

owis.original: आतां लोकीं ऐसें आहे । सृष्टीमधें वर्तताहे । जो कोणी समजोन पाहे । त्यास घडे ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगामध्यें आणि मानवसमाजामध्यें अशी परिस्थिती आहे त्याला इलाज नाहीं. जो माणूस हें समजून जगतो त्यास सुखसंतोष लाभतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Now, that atma purush is within this world beyond (prakruti) and that world beyond exists within this gross world ("I am doing everything" you say, but that is just a little thought and He is doing everything). The one who understands and sees that atma, becomes that atma.

owis.original: बहुरत्न वसुंधरा । जाणजाणों विचार करा । समजल्यां प्रत्ययो अंतरा- । माजीं येतो ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या पृथ्वीवर पुष्कळ नररत्नें आहेत. त्यांना जाणून घ्यावें व आपण विचार करावा. अशा प्रकारें जीवन समजले म्हणजे आपल्या अंतर्यामीं आपल्याला प्रचिती येते.
owis.englishMeaning: This world holds `many' jewels (ie. we see difference and give different objects, dif- ferent values) but if there is continuous knowing then, that One becomes thoughtless (but knowledge and thoughtlessness are the only jewels worth having. To acquire these one should search through this world with vivek). When to this inner space, there comes that nirgun understanding then, you come to me.

owis.original: दुर्बळ आणि संपन्न । वेडें आणि वित्पन्न । हें अखंड दंडायमान । असतचि असे ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एक दरिद्री तर एक श्रीमंत, एक वेडा तर एक विद्वान, अशी जगाची राहाटी पूर्वीपासून चालत आलेली आहे. हा भेद असाच कायम राहाणार.
owis.englishMeaning: There is the weak and there is the accomplished; there is the foolish and there is the proficient. Yet that thoughtless unbroken Self is always as It is (ie. beyond these two worlds).

owis.original: येक भाग्यपुरुष मोडती । येक नवे भाग्यवंत होती । तैसीच विद्या वित्पत्ती । होत जाते ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एके काळी संपत्तिमान असलेलेम पुरुष कालंतरानें संपत्तिहीन बनतात. आणि नविन संपत्तिमान पुरुष पुढें येतात. विद्येच्या आणि ज्ञानाच्या बाबतींतही असेंच घडतें.
owis.englishMeaning: Just as it is that One blessed purush who gets broken into pieces, so too, it is that One purush who is the possessor of the nine auspicious devotions. But even if that One is fully conversant with all the knowledges of this world still, he has come and so he will have to go (that understanding, `I was never born' has not been understood).

owis.original: येक भरे येक रितें । रितें मागुतें भरतें । भरतेंहि रितें होतें । काळांतरीं ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एक भरतें, दुसरें रिकामें होते. रिकामें झालेलें पुनः भरते. कालांतरानें जें भरलेलें असरें तें पुनः रिकामें होऊन जाते.
owis.englishMeaning: Within this `time of the all', there is that One full of worldly knowledge (ie. scholar) and that One who is empty (ie. a child); and then the empty later becomes filled and the filled also becomes empty again. (The child is like a clean slate and on it much worldly knowledge is put, but in the end that all becomes zero. maharaj- He may have trained at the Royal College of Surgeons in London but when he dies, he has to learn his A,B,C's all over again)

owis.original: ऐसी हे सृष्टीची चाली । संपत्ति दुपारची साउली । वयेसा तरी निघोन गेली । हळुहळु ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सृष्टीचा व्यवहार हा असा चालतो. दुपारची सावली जशी तात्पुरती तशीच संपत्तिची स्थिती असतें. माणसाचें आयुष्य न कळत हळुहळु कमी होत असते.
owis.englishMeaning: In this way, that thoughtless Self functions in the gross world. And such wealth acquired here is like the shadow of an afternoon. Then life bursts out and slowly it will slip away.

owis.original: बाळ तारुण्य आपलें । वृधाप्य प्रचितीस आलें । ऐसें जाणोन सार्थक केलें । पाहिजे कोणियेकें ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बाळपण जातें, तरुणपण जातें आणि म्हातारपण अनुभवास येते.हें ओळखून प्रत्येकानें आपलें सार्थक करुन घ्यावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Your childhood, youthfulness and old age have come upon this `experience'.6 By me- ans of this knowing (`experience'), that One who is within everyone should understand the meaning of this life (only when you drop all concepts and abide in this knowledge, can that Self be understood).

owis.original: देह जैसें केलें तैसें होतें । येत्न केल्यां काये साधतें । तरी मग कष्टाचें तें । काये निमित्य ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहाला जसें वागवावें तसें तो वागायला शिकतो. माणसानें प्रयत्न केला तर त्याला कोणतेही कार्य साध्य करतां येते. असें असल्यानें मग विनाकारण कष्ट करण्याचें कांहींच कारण नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Whatever one of the four bodies is created, like that one becomes. Great endeavour accomplishes this action of the `all' (ie. fourth body) and then afterwards, when that Reality is achieved, how can there be the ground for any trouble (this `all' is the source/ground of the `many' troubles). .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Tatva Nirupan (A Discourse on the Elements/Principles)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: नाभीपासून उन्मेषवृत्ती । तेचि परा जाणिजे श्रोतीं । ध्वनिरुप पश्यंती । हृदईं वसे ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बेंबीजवळ जें प्रथम स्फुरण होतें, त्यास परा वाणी म्हणतात. ती स्फूरणरुप वृत्ति हृदयांत येऊन ध्वनिरुप बनते. तिला पश्यन्ति वाणी असें म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: From the navel there arises this inspiration vritti (to know) and that Reality has become this para speech. This should be known in the listener. The pashyanti speech is of the nature of an empty sound and it stays in the heart (ie. thoughts are beginning to arise but have not been formulated).

owis.original: कंठापासून नाद जाला । मध्यमा वाचा बोलिजे त्याला । उच्चार होतां अक्षराला । वैखरी बोलिजे ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हृदयांतील ध्वनि कंठांत येऊन नादाचें रुप धारण करतो. त्यास मध्यमा वाणी असें म्हणतात. जिभेनें नादाचा शब्दरुप उच्चार होतो. त्यास वैखरी वाणी असें म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Then it appears in the form of a fond noise at the position of the throat (one is inclined to say something, for a thought has been formed). This is the madhyama/middle speech and therefore this `word' should be `spoken'. Otherwise that imperishable brahman becomes the utterance of some words. Therefore this vaikhari (ie. articulate word) should `speak' that `word' (the last two forms should `speak' this `I am'; this means that thinking ie. formulation of thoughts should cease; they should be silenced and then only knowing remains ie. para).

owis.original: नाभिस्थानीं परा वाचा । तोचि ठाव अंतकर्णाचा । अंतःकर्णपचंकाचा । निवाडा ऐसा ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बेंबीपाशी राहणारी, केवळ स्फुरणरुप असणारी परा वाणी, हेंच अंतःकरणाचें स्थान होय. आतां अंतःकरण पंचकाचें स्वरुप ऐकावें.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is this para speech at the place of the navel then, that paramatma has become this place of the inner faculty of knowing/antah-karana and then That gets divided into five aspects.

owis.original: निर्विकल्प जें स्फुरण । उगेंच असतां आठवण । तें जाणावें अंतःकर्ण । जाणतीकळा ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण उगीच बसलों असतां सहज एखादी आठवण व्हावी, त्याचप्रमाणें ज्याच्यामध्यें कल्पना नाहींअसे जें स्फुरण तें अंतःकरण जाणावें. जाणीव किंवा जागृति कळा ती हीच होय. जाणिवेचें अगदी स्वच्छ स्वरुप म्हणजे अंतःकरण होय. कोणत्याही प्रकारचे रुप न घेतलेली आणि केवळ जीवाच्या असणेपणाची आठवण ठेवणारी जी शुद्ध, कल्पनारहित जाणीव तिचें नांव अंतःकरण होय.
owis.englishMeaning: When that nirvikalpa (ie. thoughtless) is this inspiration of mula maya then, that still and silent Self is remembering. When that Reality (no knowledge and no ignorance) is this `art' of knowing then, That should be known as the antah-karana. (This `I am' or knowing of the para speech is a form of remembering; that Reality is remembering its Self ie. knows its own reflection)

owis.original: अंतःकर्ण आठवलें । पुढें होये नव्हेसें गमलें । करुं न करु ऐसें वाटलें । तेंचि मन ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतःकरणांत सहज आठवलें तेथें अंतःकरण प्रत्ययास आलें. पण जें आठवलें तें होईल का नाहीं, करावें कां न करावें अशी जाणीवेची दोलायमान स्थिति नंतर झाली, तेंच मन होय.
owis.englishMeaning: This antah-karana just remembers and then afterwards, the thoughts like "Is it or is it not?" or "To do or not to do?" appear. Then that Reality has become the mind (maharaj- first there is just knowing...then something is there/knowledge but you don't know what it is/ignorance... rajo guna has come).

owis.original: संकल्प विकल्प तेंचि मन । जेणेंकरितां अनुमान । पुढें निश्र्चयो तो जाण । रुप बुद्धीचें ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: संकल्पविकल्प करणारी जी जाणीव तेंच मन समजावें. अंतरी जेव्हां अनुमान करणें चालतें. आणि त्यांतूनच जेव्हां निश्र्चय घडतो, तेव्हां जाणीवेला बुद्धीचें रुप आलें असें समजावें.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is this *sankalp and vikalp then, that Reality has become the mind and on account of this, there is conjecture. And afterwards when a decision is reached, then know that as the buddhi.7 *(sankalp- a resolve ie. it is, and vikalpa- its opposing thought ie. or it is not)

owis.original: करीनचि अथवा न करी । ऐसा निश्र्चयोचि करी । तेचि बुद्धि हे अंतरीं । विवेकें जाणावी ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: " मी हें करीन " किंवा " मी हें करणार नाहीं " असा जी निश्र्चय करते तीच बुद्धि होय. विवेकानें आपल्या अंतर्यामी हें जाणावें.
owis.englishMeaning: "It will be done" or "It will not be done". When in this way a decision is made then, that Reality has become the buddhi/intellect. Therefore through vivek the buddhi should know that thoughtless Reality within this inner space (ie. the body buddhi should become the atma buddhi).

owis.original: जे वस्तुचा निश्र्चये केला । पुढें तेचि चिंतूं लागला । तें चित्त बोलिल्या बोला । येथार्थ मानावें ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बुद्धीनें ज्या गोष्टीचा निश्र्चय केलेला असतो त्या गोष्टीचें मग चिंतन सुरु होते. असें चिंतन करणें तें चित्त होय. येथें जे सांगितलें आहे तें खरें मानावें.
owis.englishMeaning: It is this buddhi/intellect that has decided that this `I am' of that nirgun Self, is some particular thing and then afterwards that Reality begins to think about this only.8 Then That has become the chitta (then that pure knowledge gets regarded as 7 siddharameshwar maharaj- When there is the establishment of a thought then the Self gets called conviction/buddhi. And when a doubt of that thought appears then the Self gets called mind. The con- viction/buddhi and the mind are really of one nature but it is the conviction/buddhi that decides that the One Self is a particular thing and as soon as this is determined, the buddhi stops. This means that the understanding has become gross or objective. Once the mind has determined or decided that the Self is a particular thing then the mind, known as conviction/buddhi, does not think any further. Once the mind has become objective and does not think further or move on from within this state that the conviction/buddhi has decided upon, then even in hundreds of births, that Supreme Self remains firmly fixed as something. Nothing is there but still if the conviction/buddhi decides it is something then it actually will be there, even though it is not. something other than this knowledge `I am' and there is the thinking about this over and over again). But truly this chitta should have regard for this `speech' that had been `spoken' previously. (maharaj chit is knowledge, to know; and chitta is to think about over and over again; that is why there are two t's)

owis.original: पुढें कार्याचा अभिमान धरणें । हें कार्ये तों अगत्य करणें । ऐस्या कार्यास प्रवर्तणें । तोचि अहंकार ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नंतर त्या कार्याचा अभिमान धरुन " हें कार्य मी अवश्य करीन " अशा आग्रहानें कार्यास आरंभ करणें याचें नांव अहंकार होय. अहंकारामध्यें जाणीवेला एक स्वरुपाचें घट्ट स्वरुप येते. म्हणून त्यामध्यें हट्ट किंवा आग्रह आढळतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then afterwards one firmly holds the pride/abhiman of this *action and the certainty that "I do". When such action is entered upon then, that paramatma has become the ahamkara/ego. *(In truth, that purush is the `doer' of this action and all actions take place in this knowledge, but the imagined ego says, "I am doing")

owis.original: ऐसे अंतःकर्णपंचक । पंच वृत्ती मिळोन येक । कार्येभागे प्रकारपंचक । वेगळाले ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मूळ अंतःकरण एकच आहे. पण निरनिराळ्या कार्यामुळें एकाच अंतःकरणाची पांच रुपें आढळतात. प्रत्येक रुपाला वृत्ति म्हणतात. पांच वृत्ति मिळून अंतःकरण एकच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Like this is the *fivefold `faculty of knowing'/antah-karana. When these five come together they become this knowing vritti. But due to the desire to accomplish an action, these five are separately formed. *(inspiration/antah-karana, mind, buddhi, chitta and ahankar )

owis.original: जैसे पांचहि प्राण । कार्येभागे वेगळाले जाण । नाहीं तरी वायोचें लक्षण । येकचि असे ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निरनिराळ्या कार्यामुळें पांच प्राण वेगळाले भासतात. परंतु हे वायूचे विभाग आहेत. आणि तो वायु मुळांत एकच असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: In the same way, this wind gets separated into five pranas due to this desire to accomplish an action and then they are known separately. But if there is no action to be accomplished then, that One is this wind (ie. let whatever has to come, come; why should I care; then there is just the one `moving' action, `I am everywhere').

owis.original: सर्वांगीं व्यान नाभीं समान । कंठी उदान गुदीं अपान । मुखीं नासिकीं प्राण । नेमस्त जाणावा ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: व्यान नांवाचा प्राण सर्वांग व्यापून असतो. समान प्राण नाभीच्या ठिकाणीं राहातो. उदान प्राण कंठात राहतो. अपान प्राण गुदस्थानीं वस्ती करतो. आणि प्रण हा तोंडांत आणि नाकांत राहातो. हें निश्र्चितपणें जाणावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Within this `all' body of the wind there is vyana; in the navel there is the samana; the udana is in the throat; the apana is in the anus and the prana is in the mouth and nose. Therefore this limited jiva should know this `all' (ie. when the wind that moves Self is some particular thing and as soon as it has determined this then, the intellect stops working. This means that you have become objective. Once it has been determined or decided that the Self is a particular thing then that particular thing will appear and then the mind, known here as intellect, does not think any further. Once the mind has become objective and it does not move on from this condition that the intellect has decided upon then, even after hundreds of births, that Supreme Self will remain firmly established as some thing. Nothing is there but still if the intellect decides something is, then it actually will be there, even though it is not. this pervading `all' takes itself to be a limited body then it becomes the different pranas functioning in the different parts of the body).

owis.original: बोलिलें हें प्राणपंचक । आतां ज्ञानइंद्रियेंपंचक । श्रोत्र त्वचा चक्षु जिव्हा नासिक । ऐसीं हें ज्ञानेंद्रियें ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्राणपंचक सांगून झालें. आतां ज्ञानेंद्रियपंचक सांगतो. कान, त्वचा, डोळे, जीभ आणि नाक हीं पांच ज्ञानेंद्रियें आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: That thoughtless Self has become this `speech' (ie. wind) and then It has become the fivefold prana. Now, there are the five sense organs. They are the ears, skin, eyes, tongue and nose. In this way, that thoughtless Self becomes the sense organs.

owis.original: वाचा पाणी पाद शिस्न गुद । हे कर्मइंद्रियें प्रसिद्ध । शब्द स्परुष रुप रस गंध । ऐसें हें विषयपंचक ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वाणी, हात, पाय, जननेंद्रिय आणि गुद हीं पांच कर्मेंद्रिय म्हणून प्रसिद्ध आहेत. शब्द, स्पर्श, रुप, रस व गंध असें पांच विषय आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: And when there is the speech, hands, feet, penis and anus then, that unmanifest thoughtless Self, manifests as these five organs of action. When there is a sound, touch, shape, taste or smell then, that thoughtless Self is the five sense objects.

owis.original: अंतःकर्ण प्राणपंचक । ज्ञानेंद्रियें कर्मेंद्रियें पंचक । पांचवें विषयपंचक । ऐसीं हे पांच पंचकें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतःकरणपंचक, प्राणपंचक, ज्ञानेंद्रियपंचक, कर्मेंद्रियपंचक आणि विषयपंचक अशी पांच पंचकें आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: Thus there is the antah-karana, the fivefold prana, the sense organs, the action organs and the objects of sense-organs. Due to these, that thoughtless Self has been divided into five parts for each of the five elements.

owis.original: ऐसे हे पंचविस गुण । मिळोन सूक्ष्म देह जाण । याचा कर्दम बोलिला श्रवण । केलें पाहिजे ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या पांच पंचकांची मिळून पंचवीस तत्वें होतात. ही पंचवीस तत्वें एकमेकांत मिसळून सूक्ष्म देह बनतो. या मिश्रणाची माहिती ऐकणें जरुर आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: In this way, when that thoughtless Self, this pure sattwa guna and these twenty-five parts are mixed together then, that brahman is believed to be a body. Therefore this `speech' made by the intimate companionship of prakruti and purush should be listened to.

owis.original: अंतःकर्ण व्यान श्रवण वाचा । शब्दविषये आकाशाचा । पुढें विस्तार वायोचा । बोलिला असे ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतःकरण, व्यान, कान, वाणी व शब्द यांचा संबंध आकाशाशी आहे. पुढें वायूचा विस्तार सांगतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The antah-karana, the vyana, shravan/listening, vacha/speech and the word belong to the element space. Then ahead when this `speech' expanded, there was the wind element.

owis.original: मन समान त्वचा पाणी । स्पर्श रुप हा पवनीं । ऐसे हे अडाखे साधुनी । कोठा करावा ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मन, समान, त्वचा, हात, स्पर्श व रुप यांचा संबंध वायूशी आहे. असें परस्पर संबंध मनामध्यें जुळवून एक कोष्टक तयार करावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Then there is the mind, the samana, the skin, the hands and the object of touch and that thoughtless Self is the wind element. Therefore by the skill of the sadhu (ie. knowledge becomes no knowledge), thoughtlessness should be determined.

owis.original: बुद्धि उदान नयेन चरण । रुपविषयाचें दर्शन । संकेतें बोलिलें मन । घालून पाहिजे ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बुद्धि, उदान, डोळे, पाय व रुपाचें दर्शन, हें खुणेनें सांगितलें. त्यांत लक्ष घालून विचार करावा.
owis.englishMeaning: If not, then that darshan of God is the buddhi, udana, eyes, feet and the object seen. Therefore by making this `I am' (ie. forget everything), the mind should establish itself in this `speech'.

owis.original: चित्त अपान जिव्हा शिस्न । रसविषये आप जाण । पुढें ऐका सावधान । पृथ्वीचें रुप ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चित्त, अपान, जीभ, जननेंद्रिय आणि रस यांचा संबंध पाण्याशी आहे. आतां पृथ्वीचें रुप सांगतों तें लक्षपूर्वक ऐका.
owis.englishMeaning: Know the water element as the chitta, the apana, the tongue, the penis and the object of taste. Then afterwards there comes the forms of the earth element; therefore listen carefully and form this `speech'.

owis.original: अहंकार प्राण घ्राण । गुद गंधविषये जाण । ऐसें केलें निरुपण । शास्त्रमतें ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अहंकार, प्राण, नाक, गुद आणि गंध यांचा पृथ्वीशी संबंध आहे. शास्त्राच्या आधारानें वरील प्रतिपादन केलेलें आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Know this as ego/ahankar, prana, nose, anus and object of smell. But all this that has been explained above is merely the opinions of the shasthras (ie. these are all concepts).

owis.original: ऐसा हा सूक्ष्म देहे । पाहातां होईजे निसंदेहे । येथें मन घालून पाहे । त्यासीच हें उमजे ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपला सूक्ष्मदेह हा असा आहे. तो जर नीट बघितला तर माणूस निःसंदेह होतो. या विषयांत मन घालून जो पाहिल त्यालाच हें बरोबर ध्यानांत येईल.
owis.englishMeaning: In these ways, that thoughtless Self has become this subtle body, but if you un- derstand vivek then, there will be no body consciousness whatsoever. Therefore one should be established `here' in this `speech' and then that thoughtless paramatma can be understood.

owis.original: ऐसें सूक्ष्म देहे बोलिलें । पुढें स्थूळ निरोपिलें । आकाश पंचगुणें वर्तलें । कैसें स्थुळीं ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा रीतीनें सूक्ष्मदेहाचे वर्णन केलें. यानंतर स्थूलाचा विचार सांगतो. स्थूलामध्यें आकाश पांच गुणांनी कसें व्यक्त रुप धारण करतें तें आतां सांगतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Thoughtlessness has become this `speech' and then this became the subtle body and then afterwards, the gross body. Then it will be asked, "What are the five properties of space that exist in the gross body?"

owis.original: काम क्रोध शोक मोहो भये । हा पंचविध आकाशाचा अन्वये । पुढें पंचविध वायो । निरोपिला ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कान, क्रोध, शोक, मोह, आणि भय या पांच गोष्टींचा आकाशाशीं संबंध असतो. पुढें वायूचे पांच प्रकार सांगतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that thoughtless Self is desire/kama, anger/krodha, sorrow, enticement or *fear then, it is due to its connection with this space element. And ahead, the five types of wind will be discoursed. *(maharaj- in space fear must be there...you are in a dark place and you think, `Oh! What is that?' Nothing is there but you think something is there and have fear)

owis.original: चळण वळण प्रासारण । निरोध आणि अकोचन । हें पंचविध लक्षण । प्रभंजनाचें ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चळण, वळण, प्रसारण, निरोध आणि आकुंचन हें पांच गुण वायूचे आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is movement, turning, expansion, prevention and contraction then, that attentionless Self is this attention that brings these five forms of wind.

owis.original: क्षुधा त्रुषा आलस्य निद्रा मैथुन । हे तेजाचे पंचविध गुण । आतां पुढें आपलक्षण । निरोपिलें पाहिजे ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भूक, तहान, आळस, झोप, मैथुन हे पांच गुण तेजाचे आहेत. आतां पाण्याचे गुण सांगतो.
owis.englishMeaning: And when there is hunger, thirst, laziness, sleep or sexual intercourse then, that thoughtless Self has become these fire forms of fire. Now ahead, the attention of water should be discoursed.

owis.original: शुक्लीत श्रोणीत लाळ मूत्र स्वेद । हा पंचविध आपाचा भेद । पुढें पृथ्वी विशद । केली पाहिजे ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: रेत, रक्त, लाळ, मूत्र व घाम हें पाण्याचे पांच भेद आहेत. आतां पृथ्वीचे भेद स्पष्ट करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is semen, blood, saliva, urine and sweat then, that thoughtless Self has divided into these five forms of water. Ahead, this earth should be made that clear, vast nirgun.

owis.original: अस्ति मांष त्वचा नाडी रोम । हे पृथ्वीचे पंचविध धर्म । ऐसे स्थूळ देहाचें वर्म । बोलिलें असे ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हाडें, मांस, त्वचा, नाडी व रोम हे पांच पृथ्वीचे धर्म आहेत. असें हें स्थूल देहाचे वर्म सांगितलें.
owis.englishMeaning: But when there are bones, flesh, skin, veins and hair then, our thoughtless inherent nature has become these five forms of the earth element.

owis.original: पृथ्वी आप तेज वायो आकाश । हे पांचाचे पंचविस । ऐसें मिळोन स्थूळ देहास । बोलिजेतें ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पृथ्वी, आप, तेज, वायु व आकाश यापंचभूतांचे पंचवीस गुण मिळून स्थूल देह बनतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the earth/prithvi, the water/ap, the fire/tej, the wind/vayu and the space/akash elements then, that thoughtless Self has been divided into these twenty- five divisions of the gross body. Therefore these should be brought together and this `speech' should be made.

owis.original: तिसरा देह कारण अज्ञान । चौथा देह माहांकारण ज्ञान । हे च्यारी देह निर्शितां विज्ञान । परब्रह्म तें ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तिसरा देह कारण देह होय. हा अज्ञानरुप असतो. चौथा देह माहाकारण देह होय. हा ज्ञानरुप असतो. स्थूल, सूक्ष्म, कारण, व माहाकारण हे चारही देह  निरसन केलें म्हणजे विज्ञान प्राप्त होते. जीव परब्रह्मरुप बनतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The third body is the causal body of ignorance (ie. the cause of the subtle and gross bodies) and the fourth body is the great causal body of knowledge. But when thought- lessness eliminates these four bodies then there is vignyan and that is parabrahman.

owis.original: विचारें चौदेहावेगळें केलें । मीपण तत्वासरिसें गेलें । अनन्य आत्मनिवेदन जालें । परब्रह्मीं ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विचारानें चौदेहावेगळें व्हावें. तत्वांच्या बरोबर मीपण नाहींसे करावें. म्हणजे परब्रह्माशी अनन्य आत्मनिवेदन साधतें.
owis.englishMeaning: When the four separate bodies are made into that thoughtless Self, then this `I-ness' along with the elements are thrown away and there is `no-otherness' and that antaratma gets offered to parabrahman.

owis.original: विवेकें चुकला जन्म मृत्य । नरदेहीं साधिलें महत्कृत्य । भक्तियोगें कृत्यकृत्य । सार्थक जालें ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मानात्म विवेकानें जन्ममृत्युच्या चक्रांतून सुटका होतें. मरदेहांत येऊन फार मोठें कार्य साधतें. भक्तीच्या योगानें कृतकृत्यता येऊन जन्माचें सार्थक होतें.
owis.englishMeaning: By vivek, birth and death are avoided and in this human body, that greatest deed has been achieved. By means of this devotion, the purpose of life has been fully accom- plished.

owis.original: इति श्री पंचीकर्ण । केलेंचि करावें विवर्ण । लोहाचें जालें सुवर्ण । परिसाचेनयोगें ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पंचीकरण येथें संपलें. त्याचे पुनः पुनः विवरण करावें. परिसाशी स्पर्श झाल्यानें लोखंडाचें सोनें होतें. त्याचप्रमाणें पंचीकरण विवेकानें जीव ब्रह्मस्वरुप बनतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Thus there is the end of *panchikarana (ie. the differentiation of the elements into divisions of five) when one investigates over and over again. In this way, iron becomes gold due to its union with the parees stone. *(siddharameshwar maharaj placed a lot of importance on learning this creation and dissolution of the elements)

owis.original: हाहि दृष्टांत घडेना । परिसाचेन परीस करवेना । शरण जातां साधुजना । साधुच होइजे ॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पण हा दृष्टंत देखील अपुरा आहे. परीसाला परीस बनवता येत नाहीं. पण माणुस साधुला शरण गेला तर तो स्वतः साधु बनतो. साधु स्वतः परब्रह्मस्वरुप असतो. शरणागताला तो स्वतःसारखा परब्रह्मस्वरुप बनवून टाकतो.
owis.englishMeaning: However even this simile for thoughtlessness is not entirely proper (ie. due to this end of panchikarana, knowledge is attained). For the parees cannot make the iron into a parees stone like itself. But the one who surrenders to the sadhu will become a sadhu. .

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: स्थूळ सूक्ष्म कारण माहाकारण । ऐसे हे चत्वार देह जाण । जागृति स्वप्न सुषुप्ति पूर्ण । तुर्या जाणावी ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्थूल, सूक्ष्म, कारण व महाकारण असे चार देह आहेत. जागृति,स्वप्न, सुषुप्ति आणि तुर्या या चार अवस्था आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the gross, subtle, causal and the great causal then, know that the thoughtless Self has become these four bodies. Therefore one should know the waking, dream, sleep and turya states and be complete.

owis.original: विश्व तैजस प्राज्ञ । प्रत्यगात्मा हे अभिमान । नेत्रस्थान कंठस्थान हृदयस्थान । मूर्धनी ते ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विश्व, तेजस, प्राज्ञ आणि प्रत्यगात्मा हे चार देहाचे चार अभिमान आहेत. जागेपणीं  " हा देह मी आहे " असा अभिमान असणारा तो विश्व होय. स्वप्न पडत असतांना वावरणारा " मी " तो तैजस होय. गाढ झोपेंत शांत असणरा " मी " तो प्राज्ञ होय. आणि तुरीय अवस्थेमध्यें जो साक्षीरुप अंतरात्मा असतो     , तो प्रत्यगात्मा होय. विश्र्वाचे स्थान नेत्र, तैजसाचे स्थान कंठ, प्राज्ञाचें स्थान हृदय आणि प्रत्यगात्म्याचे स्थान टाळू होय.
owis.englishMeaning: When that thoughtless Self has pride/ego then, there is the vishwa of the physical body, the taijas of the subtle body, the pragnya of the causal body and the pratyag- atma of great causal body. Then that Reality is said to reside in the eyes, the throat, the heart and in the crown of the head respectively.

owis.original: स्थूळभोग प्रविक्तभोग । आनंदभोग आनंदावभासभोग । ऐसे हे चत्वार भोग । चौदेहाचे ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्थूलभोग स्थूलदेहाचा, प्रविक्र भोग सूक्ष्म देहाचा, अनंदभोग कारण देहाचा आणि आनंदावभासभोग महाकारण देहाचा होय. प्रतिविविक्त म्हणजे निवडून वेगळा केलेला असा. स्वप्नामध्यें भोग असतो पण तो सामान्य स्थू;भोग नसतो. ज्ञात्यानें किंवा भोक्त्यानें एक प्रकारें निवडलेला भोग असतो. म्हणून तो प्रविविक्त भोग होय. सुषुप्तीच्या पलीकडे पण परब्रह्माच्या अलीकडे आनंदमय कोशामध्यें जो आनंदाचा भोग होतो तो महाकारण देहाचा आनंदावभासभोग होय.
owis.englishMeaning: When that thoughtless Self is the four enjoyments of the four bodies then, there is the enjoyment of the gross objects, the dream objects, the causal body enjoys bliss/ananda and the great causal body enjoys objectless bliss.

owis.original: अकार उकार मकार । अर्धमात्रा तो ईश्र्वर । ऐस्या मात्रा चत्वार । चौदेहाच्या ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अकार स्थूल देहाची मात्रा, उकार सूक्ष्म देहची मात्रा, मकार कारण देहाची मात्रा आणि जिला ईश्र्वर म्हणतात ती महाकारण देहाची अर्धमात्रा होय. ओंकारांतून सर्व विश्र्व निर्माण झालें असा सिद्धान्त आहे. ओंकारावरील जी अर्धमात्रा ती बिंदूनें दर्शवितात. अकार म्हणजेम जड पंचभूतें,  उकार म्हणजे जीवनकला,  मकार म्हणजे अंतःकरण आणि अर्ध मात्रा म्हणजे अंतरात्मा होय.
owis.englishMeaning: Then there is the a-form, u-form, m-form and the half vowel and that hidden ishwara (ie. purush). Such are the four vowels of the four bodies (a is vishnu, u is brahma, m is mahesh and the fourth is the pure sattwa guna. It are represented by the point of the aum symbol).

owis.original: तमोगुण रजोगुण । सत्वगुण शुद्धसत्वगुण । ऐसे हे चत्वार गुण । चौदेहाचे ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तमोगुण स्थूलदेहाचा, रजोगुण सूक्ष्मदेहाचा, सत्त्वगुण कारणदेहाचा आणि शुद्धसत्त्वगुण महाकारण देहाचा होय.
owis.englishMeaning: Then there is tamo guna, rajo guna, sattva guna and pure sattva guna. In this way that thoughtless Self is the four gunas of the four bodies.

owis.original: क्रियाशक्ति द्रव्यशक्ती । इच्छाशक्ति ज्ञानशक्ती । ऐशा चत्वार शक्ती । चौदेहाच्या ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: क्रियाशक्ति म्हणजे कर्म करण्याची शक्ति, द्रव्यशक्ति म्हणजे दृश्य पदार्थांतील सुप्तशक्ति होय. इच्छाशक्ति म्हणजे माणसाच्या वासनांना ताजेपणा ठेवावयास लागणारी अविद्या होय. ज्ञानशक्ति म्हणजे '" मी आत्मस्वरुप आहे " या अनुभवांतून निर्माण होणारे सामर्थ्य होय.
owis.englishMeaning: The power of action, the power of matter (to make substantial or to become ob- jective), the power of the `wish', and the power of knowledge. Such are the four powers/shakti of these four bodies.

owis.original: ऐसीं हे बत्तिस तत्वें । दोहींचीं पन्नास तत्वें । अवघीं मिळोन ब्यासि तत्वें । अज्ञान आणि ज्ञान ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशी ही बत्तीस तत्वें आहेत. त्यांच्यामध्यें पूर्वींची स्थूलदेहाची पंचवीस व सूक्ष्मदेहाची पंचवीस मिळून पन्नास तत्वें मिसळलीं कीं, ब्याऐशीं तत्वें होतात. शिवाय ज्ञान आणि अज्ञान हीं दोन्ही आणखीं घालायची. अशी एकंदर चौर्‍यांशीं तत्वें होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: That thoughtless Self then has thirty-two principles along with the previous fifty principles of the gross and subtle bodies. And in everyone these eighty-two are mixed along with ignorance and knowledge. Note: the attention that brings the eighty-four principles that make up a jiva.

owis.original: ऐसीं हे तत्वें जाणावी । जाणोन माइक वोळखावीं । आपण साक्षी निरसावीं । येणें रीतीं ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तत्त्वें अशी आहेत तें ओळखावें. तीं सारी मायिक आहेत हें जाणावें. आपण साक्षीपणानें राहून त्यांचे निरसन करावें.
owis.englishMeaning: That thoughtless Self is the Knower of these principles and by knowing, that One will recognize these as false (ie. the eighty-two principles are discarded and knowledge remains). Then thoughtlessness should discard you as this Witness.

owis.original: साक्षी म्हणिजे ज्ञान । ज्ञानें वोळखावें अज्ञान । ज्ञाानाज्ञानाचें निर्शन । देहासरिसें ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: साक्षीपणा म्हणजे ज्ञान होय. त्या ज्ञानानें अज्ञान ओळखावें. देहाचा निरास झाला म्हणजे ज्ञान व अज्ञान दोन्हींचा निरास होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Witness means knowledge. You should recognize that ignorance is with knowledge (ie. the two sides of the one coin; knowledge is ignorance of that Reality). And then, along with the other two bodies, there should be the destruction of knowledge and ignorance.

owis.original: ब्रह्मांडीं देह कल्पिले । विराट हिरण्यगर्भ बोलिले । ते हे विवेकें निर्शले । आत्मज्ञानें ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पिंडाच्या देहावरुन ब्रह्मांडाच्या देहाची कल्पना केलेली आहे. त्यांना विराट व हिरण्यगर्भ अशीं नांवें आहेत. आत्मज्ञानानें विवेक केला म्हणजे त्यांचेही निरसन होऊन जाते.
owis.englishMeaning: When in the brahmanda, bodies are imagined then, this `speech' has become the virat/gross universal and the hiranyagarbha/subtle universal. These are destroyed by that knowledge of atma.

owis.original: आत्मानात्मविवे करितां । सारासारविचार पाहातां । पंचभूतांची माइक वार्ता । प्रचित आली ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मानात्मविवेक केला असतां आणि सारासार विचार करुन पाहिलें असतां, पंचभूतें मायिक आहेत अशी प्रचिती येते.
owis.englishMeaning: First you have to make atma emphanatma vivek (to gain this `I am' experience) and then you have to understand that thoughtless essence. It is this `experience' that had brought the false rumour of the five elements (if they are dissolved into the previous state from where they have come then, there will be this `all' experience once more).

owis.original: अस्ति मांष त्वचा नाडी रोम । हे पांचहि पृथ्वीचे गुणधर्म । प्रत्यक्ष शरीरीं हें वर्म । शोधून पाहावें ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हाडें, मांस, त्वाचा, नाडी व रोम हे पांचही पृथ्वीचे गुणधर्म आहेत. आपण स्वतःच्या शरीरामध्यें हें वर्म प्रत्यक्ष शोधून पाहावें.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is bone, flesh, skin, veins and hair then, that thoughtless Self is these five properties of the earth element and there is the sensory experience of the gross body. But that thoughtless essence should be searched out and understood.

owis.original: शुक्लीत श्रोणीत लाळ मूत्र स्वेद । हे आपाचे पंचभेद । तत्वें समजोन विशद । करुन घ्यावीं ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: रेत, रक्त, लाळ, मूत्र, व घाम हें पाण्याचें पंचक आहे. ही तत्त्वें समजून स्पष्ट कल्पना करुन घ्यावी.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the seminal fluid, blood, saliva, urine and sweat then, that thoughtless essence is the five forms of the elemental water. When these gross elements are clearly understood then that thoughtless swarup should be made and accepted.

owis.original: क्षुधा त्रुषा आलस्य निद्रा मैथुन । हे पांचहि तेजाचे गुण । या तत्वांचें निरुपण । केलेंचि करावें ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भूक, तहान, आळस, निद्रा व मैथुन हे पांच तेजाचे गुण आहेत. या तत्त्वांचे विवेचन पुनः पुनः करावें.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is hunger, thirst, laziness, sleep and sexual intercourse then, that thou- ghtless essence is the five properties of the fire element. Therefore this sagun discourse of the gross elements should be made again and again.

owis.original: चळण वळण प्रासारण । निरोध आणि आकोचन । हे पांचहि वायोचे गुण । श्रोतीं जाणावे ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चळण, वळण, प्रसारण, निरोध आणि आकुंचन हें पांच गुण वायूचे आहेत. हे श्रोत्यांनी ओळखावें.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is movement, turning, expansion, prevention and contraction then, that thoughtless Self has become the five properties of the wind also. Therefore this `I am'/wind within the listener should be known.

owis.original: काम क्रोध शोक मोहो भये । हा आकाशाचा परियाये । हें विवरल्याविण काये । समजों जाणें ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: काम, क्रोध, शोक, मोह आणि भय हे आकाशाशी संबंधित आहेत. याचें विवरण केल्यांवांचून ते समजणार नाहींत.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is desire, anger, sorrow, enticement and fear then, that Self has be- come this space. But without proper investigation how can one ever understand this thoughtlessness?

owis.original: असो ऐसें हें स्थूळ शरीर । पंचविस तत्वांचा विस्तार । आतां सूक्ष्मदेहाचा विचार । बोलिजेल ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असो. असें हें स्थूल शरीर आहे. त्यामध्यें पंचवीस तत्त्वांचा विस्तार आढळतो. आतां सूक्ष्म देहाचा विस्तार सांगतो.
owis.englishMeaning: In this way, that thoughtless formless swarup is the gross body and Its expansion into twenty-five principles. Now the thoughtlessness that has become the subtle body should be made into this `speech'.

owis.original: अंतःकर्ण मन बुद्धि चित्त अहंकार । आकाशपंचकाचा विचार । पुढें वायो निरोत्तर । होऊन ऐका ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतःकरण, मन, बुद्धि, चित्त व अहंकार हेआकाशपंचक आहे. आतां वायूचा विचार सांगतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that thoughtless Self has the five properties of space then there is the antar- karana, mind, discriminating faculty/buddhi, chitta and ego. Ahead, listen to the wind of `I am' and then be that which is `without this reply'.

owis.original: व्यान समान उदान । प्राण आणी अपान । ऐसे हे पांचहि गुण । वायोतत्वाचे ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: व्यान, समान, उदान, अपान आणि प्राण हे पांच वायूचे गुण आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is vyana, samana, udana, prana and apana then, that thoughtless Self and this guna of the wind is these five principles.

owis.original: श्रोत्र त्वचा चक्षु जिव्हा घ्राण । हें पांचहि तेजाचे गुण । आतां आप सावधान । होऊन ऐका ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कान, त्वचा, डोळे, जीभ व नाक हे तेजाचे गुण आहेत. आतां आपगुण ऐका.
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the ears, skin, eyes, tongue and nose then, that thoughtless essence has become the five properties of the fire also. Now, there is the water, therefore be alert and listen to this `I am'.

owis.original: वाचा पाणी पाद शिस्न गुद । हे आपाचे गुण प्रसिद्ध । आतां पृथ्वी विशद । निरोपिली ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वाणी, हात, पाय, जननेंद्रिय व गुद हे पाण्याचे प्रसिद्ध गुण आहेत. आतां पृथ्वीचे गुण ऐका.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the speech, hands, feet, penis and anus then that thoughtless Self and this pure sattwa guna has become manifest as the element water. Now it will be explained how that thoughtless Self is the earth element.

owis.original: शब्द स्पर्श रुप रस गंध । हे पृथ्वीचे गुण विशद । ऐसे हे पंचवीस तत्वभेद । सूक्ष्म देहाचे ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शब्द, स्पर्श, रुप, रस व गंध हे पृथ्वीचे प्रसिद्ध गुण आहेत. अशीं हीं सूक्ष्मदेहाची पंचवीस तत्त्वें आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the word, touch, form, taste and smell then, that thoughtless clear Self and this best guna is the great earth element. In this way, that thoughtless swarup has become the twenty-five different aspects of the subtle body. Note: Therefore that thoughtless Self is not anything that can be seen or perceived by the mind. But still He is there. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Tonapa Siddha Lakshan (The Attributes of the Blockhead-Siddha)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: आवर्णोदकीं हटकेश्र्वर । त्यास घडे नमस्कार । महिमा अत्यंतचि थोर । तया पाताळलिंगाचा ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पृथ्वीच्याभोवतीं सात समुद्रांचे आवरण आहे. त्या आवरणोदकामध्यें हतकेश्र्वर नांवाचे शिवलिंग आहे. त्याला मी नमस्कार करतो. त्या पाताळलिंगाचा महिमा फार थोर आहे.
